svg.title: Four bar charts. Kubernetes code graph build, one run each on the same machine with 3 CPUs each: Graphicle's 0.1.1 memory engine (a pre-release build) 1 min 8 s, Graphify 0.9.91 25 min 47 s, 22.7× less time; the graphs differ slightly (node counts within 4.7%, edge counts within 2.0%). Kubernetes peak memory: Graphicle 0.1.1 2,148 MiB (peak RSS, highest of 2 runs), Graphify 0.9.91 2,767 MiB (peak PSS); lower in all 39 measurements on a pre-release memory build. Facts found on Graphify's showcase corpus, 30 questions: Claude Code alone 94.7%, Graphicle 99.2%, Graphify 87.8%; against Graphify +11.4 pts (95% CI [4.2, 19.7]); against Claude Code alone a tie. Median tokens per answer: Claude Code alone 60.8k, Graphicle 69.2k, Graphify 87.1k; fewer than Graphify (mean difference −31.8k, 95% CI [−58.9k, −8.2k]); against Claude Code alone no difference measured.
svg.desc: Graphicle 0.1.1 against Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) and Claude Code alone. Four bar charts. Tests run 15 Oct 2026. Agent panels: Claude Code 2.1.287, Opus 5.5, effort medium; Graphicle 0.1.1 agent defaults (pre-release build); 30 questions; paired 95% CIs. Speed panel: one session per program on the same machine, 3 CPUs and 8 workers each, 15 Oct 2026. Ties are shown as ties. Method and published results: github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md Graphify is a trademark of its owners; no affiliation or endorsement. 1) Build the code graph, Kubernetes, code-only extract. Lower is better. Graphicle 0.1.1 pre-release 1 min 8 s; Graphify 0.9.91 25 min 47 s. 22.7× less time on this run Graphicle's 0.1.1 memory engine, a pre-release build. One run each, same machine, 3 CPUs each. The graphs differ slightly: nodes within 4.7%, edges within 2.0%. 2) Peak memory, Kubernetes, code-only extract. Lower is better. Graphicle 0.1.1 2,148 MiB; Graphify 0.9.91 2,767 MiB. Lower in all 39 measurements Graphicle's peak RSS (highest of 2 runs) against Graphify's peak PSS. The 39: 13 repos × 3 operations, pre-release memory build; the graphs differ. 3) Facts found, Graphify's showcase corpus, 30 questions. Higher is better. Claude Code alone 94.7%; Graphicle 0.1.1 99.2%; Graphify 0.9.91 87.8%. More than Graphify: +11.4 pts 95% CI [4.2, 19.7] vs Claude Code alone: tie 4) Tokens per answer, Same test, median per answer. Lower is better. Claude Code alone 60.8k; Graphicle 0.1.1 69.2k; Graphify 0.9.91 87.1k. Fewer than Graphify: −31.8k mean difference, 95% CI [−58.9k, −8.2k] vs Claude Code alone no difference measured
